 Appearance:
 MR ASHISH M DAGLI(2203) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3,4  DS AFF.NOT FILED (R) for the Respondent(s) No. 2  MR JAY MEHTA, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DIVYESH A. JOSHI
Date : 11/09/2024  ORAL ORDER 1.

By this application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the applicants-original accused persons seek to invoke the inherent powers of this Court praying for quashing of the F.I.R. being C.R.No.I-4 of 2015 filed before the Mahila Police Station,
District-Porbandar, for the offence punishable under Sections-498A, 323, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the I.P.C. and Sections-3 & 7 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Heard Mr. Dashit Kamdar, learned advocate who appears on behalf of Mr. Ashish Dagli, learned advocate for the applicant;Mr. Jay Mehta, learned APP for respondent no.1 - State and Mr. Darshil Prajapati, learned advocate for respondent no.2 - original complainant.

sentences.text: Mr. Dashit Kamdar, learned advocate appearing for the applicant submits that the marriage of the applicant no.1 was solemnized with respondent no.2 on 28.05.2005 and since then, they were residing together in a joint family.

He further submits that thereafter, after a period of some time,
the disputes cropped up between the husband and wife due to small and petty issued and therefore,
the wife had gone to her parental home and residing with her parents.
On 09.02.2015, the respondent no.2 - wife has lodged a complant against the husband and in-laws with Mahila Police Station, Porbandar.
As soon as the said fact came to the knowledge of the applicanta, they have approached this Hon'ble Court by way of preferring present application.
Considering the allegations levelled against the applicants-accused, a co-ordinate bench of this Court has passed an order by protecting the applicants- accused.

Learned advocate further submits that during the pendency of present proceedings, the matter has already been amicably settled between the parties outside of the Court and the complainant is not willing to carry out the proceedings further.
The respondent no.2 - original complainant has filed affidavit specifically stating the said fact that if the proceedings of present complaint is quashed, in that event, she has no objection.
An affidavit to that effect has also been filed by the complainant.
It is, therefore, urged that the present applications may be allowed.

4. Learned advocate Mr. Darshil Prajapati for the respondent no.2 - original complainant has submitted that the respondent NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/8144/2015 ORDER DATED:
11/09/2024 undefined no.2 - complainant has remained present before this court by way of hybrid hearing and she has no objection, if the proceedings qua the present applicants would be quashed.
Learned advocate further submits that the disputes is settled between the parties and an affidavit in that regard is already filed by the complainant.

Learned advocate has identified the signature of the complainant as well as identified the respondent no.2 - original complainant and also confirmed correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by her.
5.
Mr. Jay Mehta, learned APP has submitted that appropriate order may be passed on the strength of the settlement arrived at between the parties.

6. Therefore, since now, the dispute with reference to the impugned FIR is settled and resolved by and between the parties, which is confirmed by the original complainant through her learned advocate, the trial would be futile and any further continuation of proceedings would amount to abuse of process of law.
Therefore, the impugned FIR is required to be quashed and set aside.
The affidavit filed by the respondent no.2- original complainant is ordered to be taken on record.
7. Resultantly, the present application is allowed.

The proceedings of F.I.R. being C.R.No.I-4 of 2015 filed before the Mahila Police Station, District-Porbandar and all other consequential proceedings arising out of said complaint are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicants herein.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/8144/2015 ORDER DATED: 11/09/2024 undefined
The Registry shall accept the vakalatnama of Mr. Darshil Prajapati, the learned advocate who appeared on behalf of the respondent no.2-original first informant.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
